name: Cyril Rollins
source: One of Taylor’s friends, Cyril is the heir to a mercantile family that trades in high quality fabrics—Rollins Textiles. He’s rather clever, quite fashionable, and a touch on the bohemian side. As his family is tainted by trade, he’s generally looked down upon by nobility despite being much richer than them, but Taylor befriended him anyway some number of years ago. Taylor is Cyril’s closest friend, and Cyril would do just about anything for him (and, in fact, has done quite a number of things for the man without his knowing).
